answer: Agents plant identities in a sealed, bioluminescent grove that locks to a single voyage path hashed into the blockchain root. Every audit probes a random node: if the bioluminescence deviates beyond a calibrated shade, the agent incurs slashing equal to its issued stake. A Sybil must replicate each shade variation, costing 0.09 stake-weight per extra head—colour drift from the grove’s cultivated alchemy resists bulk synthesis. Failed audits crash the haven.
